title: Pokémon GO: Mega Ascension
description:
Mega Ascension week prior to the Mega Finale event.

Daily Mega Raid Rotation:
- Mon, Aug 31: Mega Victreebel, Mega Dragonite, Mega Malamar
- Tue, Sep 1: Mega Falinks
- Wed, Sep 2: Mega Skarmory
- Thu, Sep 3: Mega Starmie
- Fri, Sep 4: Mega Raichu X, Mega Raichu Y
- All Week: Mega Latias, Mega Latios

Bonuses:
- Remote Raid Pass limit increased to 30.
- Special Backgrounds available for Mega Raids.

title: Pokémon GO Fest: Mega Finale
description:
Global Event. Main Raids: Armored Mewtwo, Mega Mewtwo X & Y.

Bonuses:
- Unlimited remote raids.
- Special Backgrounds available.

title: Super Mega Raid Day
description: Special Super Mega Raid Day!\n\nDetails to be officially announced but expect increased Mega Raids and bonuses!
